title: /integrations/zeversolar
description: Instructions on how to configure the Zeversolar integration within Home Assistant
body:
The **Zeversolar**  uses the local device IP to get information like the current power and
today's total energy production.
This  allows you to collect and save data providing a historical overview of your Zeversolar
production.

## Prerequisites

You need a Zeversolar inverter connected to your solar panels and Wi-Fi. Furthermore, you need to
get the Zeversolar IP address.

## Sensor types

When configured, the  will create two sensors for each configured inverter:

- Energy today, in `kWh` (Kilowatt-hour)
- Current power, in `W` (Watts)
